response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack/backend engineer with a long track record across web, mobile, embedded, and GIS systems, and meets the baseline years-of-experience and language requirements. However, the resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, A/B testing, or growth engineering — the core domain of this role — and no clear evidence of Principal-level (IC6) cross-team architectural leadership or ownership of systems used by multiple teams at enterprise scale.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across many languages and platforms (JS/TS, DLang, C, C++, Java, C#)
Entrepreneurial track record founding and maintaining an open-source geo-data platform used by real organizations
Demonstrated experience with performance/scale-sensitive systems (low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No evidence of experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or A/B testing/rollout systems
No demonstrated telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or statistical/experimental analysis experience relevant to growth systems
No clear signal of Principal/IC6-level scope — leading multi-team initiatives, cross-org architecture, or stakeholder alignment at the described enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Broad, deep generalist engineering background across many stacks
Lack of clear Principal-level cross-team leadership evidence
